message.content: {"recommended_method":"social_choice","consensus_potential":0.65,"fairness_assessment":"A ranked or criteria-based vote fairly compares visibility, long-term capacity, and resource balance; no stakeholder has an inherently dominant claim, though the debate advantage for Option B should not determine the outcome alone.","conflict_severity":"medium","stakeholder_analysis":[{"agent":"agent_1","position":"Supports dedicating the full budget to an inter-city tournament to maximize the club's visibility.","influence":0.33},{"agent":"agent_2","position":"Supports dedicating the full budget to educational materials and new chessboards to strengthen the club's long-term capabilities.","influence":0.4},{"agent":"agent_3","position":"Supports a hybrid allocation, splitting the budget between a smaller tournament and equipment.","influence":0.27}],"recommended_resolution":"compromise","governance_reasoning":"The three options reflect legitimate and partly compatible goals rather than irreconcilable interests.
